identitySignals: Trade name 'ProCare Therapy' matches the dba in the agenda text; it is registered to 'New Direction Solutions, LLC' (OpenGovUS Delaware business record), not exactly 'New Direction LLC'
ProCare Therapy provides school-based therapy staffing, consistent with OUSD's special education nonpublic agency contract
Agenda gives Newport Beach, CA, but the company's public records show Peachtree Corners, GA (previously Jacksonville, FL); no Newport Beach connection was found
research.notes: Not publishable. Agenda names 'New Direction LLC dba ProCare Therapy' in Newport Beach, CA; the ProCare Therapy found is 'New Direction Solutions, LLC' headquartered in Peachtree Corners, GA. Likely the same company (other California districts contract 'New Direction Solutions, LLC dba ProCare Therapy'), but the name and location discrepancies could not be resolved. procaretherapy.com blocks automated fetching (403), so website and contact details could not be verified.

profile.summary: ProCare Therapy is a company that places school-based therapists and related service staff, such as speech-language pathologists, occupational therapists and school psychologists, in school districts. It is the trade name of New Direction Solutions, LLC.
